capabilities: Draw a page of the linked PDF as the cover on each Bases card
Choose a cover page with #page=N in the PDF link
Browse PDF pages on a card and open the PDF at that page
Show image covers on cards without a PDF
Export the view's covers as a PNG contact sheet (Pro)
extras: Freemium: the free version draws the first 30 PDF covers per view; Pro (unlocks every card, cover crop, cached covers, contact-sheet export) needs a $15 total or $5/month GitHub Sponsors payment verified via GitHub device-flow sign-in. After updates the plugin opens a What's new tab that suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; the README details its network behavior and token storage. Requires the core Bases plugin to be enabled.
intentEvidence: It uses core Bases to select, filter and sort notes, and the PDF reader of Obsidian to draw pages.
problem: Obsidian's core Bases Cards layout shows nothing for a PDF link, so document libraries lack visual covers on their cards.
summary: Bases view plugin that draws a page of the PDF linked from each note as the card cover, with page browsing, cropping and PNG contact-sheet export.
